description: Patch an assistant. Only supplied fields change, including individual llmConfig prompt/model/temperature keys; temperature must be 0–2. Flat v3 fields and the voiceId/assistantType/subAccountId aliases are accepted; conflicting aliases are rejected; an explicit subaccount selector on the call takes precedence over the connection default and is authorized against the key. voiceConfig/chatConfig records and unknown llmConfig keys are unsupported and return errors. Use voice_settings or flat inbound_greeting/outbound_greeting for greetings; platform_tools declaratively replaces platform-catalog attachments ([] detaches all).

assistantType.description: Assistant type. STANDARD (default) is a prompt-driven assistant; FLOW_BUILDER is node/flow driven.

assistant_type.description: Assistant type. STANDARD (default) is a prompt-driven assistant; FLOW_BUILDER is node/flow driven.

model.description: LLM model, one of the AIModel enum values (e.g. KIMI_K2_6 — the default, GPT_5_6_LUNA, GPT_5, CLAUDE_4_SONNET, GEMINI_2_5_FLASH). Resolved to the provider model at agent-sync time.
LLM model, one of the AIModel enum values (e.g. KIMI_K2_6 — the default, GPT_5_6_LUNA, GPT_5, CLAUDE_4_SONNET, GEMINI_2_5_FLASH). Resolved to the provider model at agent-sync time.

platform_tools.description: Platform tool names to attach, e.g. ["book_appointment", "send_email"]. Declarative within the platform catalog: tools in the list are attached, catalog tools missing from the list are detached, custom tools are never touched. Omit for no change; [] detaches all platform tools. See GET /v3/tools for the catalog; custom tools attach via POST /v3/tools/{id}/assign.

subAccountId.description: Target subaccount id. Prefer the X-Subaccount-Id header; this body field is a fallback.

subaccount_id.description: Target subaccount id. Prefer the X-Subaccount-Id header; this body field is a fallback.

anyOf.description: Voice PK (the `id` from GET /v3/voices). Defaults to the system default voice when omitted.

enable_voicemail_detection.description: Records intent only: persisted and returned on read, but voicemail detection is currently platform-managed and this flag does not yet gate runtime behavior.

greeting_mode.description: How the assistant opens a call: `dynamic` (AI-generated opener; default), `fixed` (speaks the configured opening message verbatim), or `contact_first` (stays silent until the contact speaks).

inbound_opening_message.description: Spoken opener for inbound calls. Only valid in `fixed` greeting mode. Template variables (e.g. a contact first-name placeholder) are allowed and resolve per call. `null` clears this direction.

outbound_opening_message.description: Spoken opener for outbound calls. Only valid in `fixed` greeting mode. Template variables are allowed and resolve per call. `null` clears this direction.

voicemail_message.description: Played when voicemail is detected, after which the assistant stops. Empty or `null` means the assistant hangs up on voicemail instead.

name: assistants_update
